rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for major portions of the child. The child closely reproduces C13’s establishment-and-membership sequence, its unusually detailed alternate-member provision, and nearly verbatim agency-assistance/detailing language. These shared elements are material administrative machinery, not merely generic subject matter. C08 is substantively important because its traffic-safety program and cooperation language reappears and it is expressly incorporated as an adviser, while C21 parallels the advisory-status limitation and research-coordination functions; neither matches the child’s core drafting machinery as closely as C13.

shared_material.explanation: The establishment clause and immediate transition to an enumerated membership provision follow the same structure and wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Each head of agency referred to In subsection (b) may provide for an alternate member who shall serve as a member of the Board in lieu of the regular member representing the agency when such regular member is unable to attend any meeting of the Board; and any alternate member shall while serving as such have in all respects the same status as a member of the Board as would the regular member in whose place he Is serving.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each head of agency referred to in items (1) to (4), inclusive, in this section 1 (b) may provide for an alternate member who shall serve as a member of the Board in lieu of the regular member representing the agency concerned when such regular member is for reasons beyond his control unable to attend any meeting of the Board; and any alternate member shall while serving as such have in all respects the same status as a member of the Board as does the regular member in lieu of whom he serves.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive, extended near-verbatim match governing alternate members and their status.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Consonant with law, each agency represented on the Board shall, as may be necessary for the effectuation of the purpose of this order, furnish assistance to the Board in accordance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691). Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Board, one of whom may serve as Executive Officer, to perform such functions, consistent with the purpose of this order, as the Board may assign to them.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Consonant with law, each agency represented on the Board shall, as may be necessary for the purpose of effectuating this order, furnish assistance to the Board in accordance with section 214 of the Act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691). Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Board, one of whom may serve as its Executive Officer, to perform such functions, consistent with the purposes of this order, as the Board may assign to them.
shared_material.explanation: The child carries over virtually the entire assistance, employee-detailing, and Executive Officer provision with only minor grammatical changes.
